name: jarvis-ai-android
description: Capacitor shell that wraps the JARVIS AI web app into an Android APK.

scripts.android:add: npm run prepare:www && cap add android
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:www && cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
